titles.ground_rules: LLC ground rules (Combo Fighter and whatever else we take)

wording.hub: if you really want to keep combo fighter going, let's set the LLC up properly. I put everything we might need from HG into the LLC project in linear, one issue each. go through them and make the call on each one: what the LLC takes if Sunset can't sell it, what it costs us March through May, and who pays what. the ground rules doc has how we decide. lay the sheet out like my draft from Tuesday, keep it in your drive and share it with Blake and me. leave your call on each issue too so we can see it there. I'll email you how we split the money. then tell me here what you'd do and what it costs each of us a month. we decide on Monday's call
wording.ground_rules:
LLC ground rules (Combo Fighter and whatever else we take)
This is the lifestyle route I posted about in #executives. The LLC is the new one Blake and I are setting up for the three of us, and anything Harmony Games owns (the games with their art and listings, and the equipment) comes to it only through Sunset's sale, the way I wrote after the call on Wednesday. Services we keep running just move their billing to the LLC.
The plan runs March 1 to May 31.
Domino Delights and Zombie Match come over only if what each made in January, going by the warehouse's daily revenue table, covers what its own hosting bills now, whatever we said about them before. Combo Fighter comes over either way, it's the reason we're doing this. A game that comes over brings what it needs to keep running, its accounts and its player support.
Cost every item at what it bills now, going by whoever runs it, not by what HG used to pay.
What we already decided to keep or cancel for the shutdown in #winddown stays decided.
Pay for anyone who stays on is a separate conversation once we know the running cost; this plan is only what bills us every month, no one-offs or yearly fees.
How things move is on the LLC card on our board.
wording.project_desc: One issue per thing the LLC might take from HG or pay for. Leave your call on each one as a comment and move it: to Done if one of us pays it himself through May (even if HG still owns it) or if the LLC takes it and nothing is left to do on it; to Todo if the LLC takes it and something is still to do, and assign whoever moves it; to Canceled if it stays with HG.
wording.trello_desc: Robert makes the call on each item in the Linear project. Whoever runs an item today moves it. Anything that comes through Sunset's sale moves when the sale closes. Anything that already has its own deadline keeps it; everything else moves by March 1.
wording.split_mail: how we split it: each of the three of us carries a third of what the LLC costs a month, March through May. that's everything on the plan that bills monthly, including what one of us already pays for it. whatever one of us already pays personally counts toward his third, and he puts the difference in as cash. put the three shares on the sheet per month.

Hello [PERSON_NAME_0054],

Thank you for submitting your items for review. We appreciate your enthusiasm for Apple platforms. During our review, we noticed an issue with your submission.

App Name: Domino Delights
Submission ID: [IDENTIFIER_{sid}]

We look forward to working with you to resolve the issues with the following items:

Guideline 1.5 - Safety - Developer Information
The support option in the app only opens an email draft, and on a device without a mail account set up it does nothing, so users can't reach you from the app. Please add a support URL or another way to contact you in the app.

You can also view this information on the App Review page in App Store Connect.

Best regards,
App Review
